title: When LLMs Develop Languages: Symbolic Communication for Efficient Multi-Agent Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2606.29354v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) improves large language models (LLMs) on difficult reasoning tasks, but it often incurs long natural-language rationales that are poorly aligned with efficient machine reasoning. We propose Communicative Language Symbolism Routing (CLSR), a test-time framework in which multiple LLM agents autonomously invent, evolve, and share compact Language Symbolism Frameworks (LSFs), while a latent-free router adaptively selects and composes these languages per query to optimize the accuracy-token trade-off. Unlike prompt optimization that refines surface instructions, CLSR treats each LSF as a reusable symbolic protocol with compact symbols, usage rules, and a message-passing contract, and improves it through an evolutionary loop driven by correctness and token cost. translated_title: 当大语言模型发展出自己的语言：面向高效多智能体推理的符号化通信
translated_abstract: 思维链提升了大语言模型在困难推理任务上的表现，但它往往产生冗长的自然语言推理过程，这与高效的机器推理并不匹配。我们提出了通信语言符号路由（CLSR），这是一个测试时框架，其中多个LLM智能体自主发明、演化并共享紧凑的语言符号框架（LSF），同时由一个无潜变量路由器根据每个查询自适应地选择和组合这些语言，以优化准确率与token开销之间的权衡。与仅优化表层指令的提示优化方法不同，CLSR将每个LSF视为可复用的符号协议，包含紧凑符号、使用规则和消息传递契约，并通过由正确性和token成本共同驱动的演化循环不断改进。在推理时，路由器可以调用单个低成本的LSF、集成多个LSF，或在更难的查询上执行多轮LSF组合协议。
tldr: 提出了CLSR测试时框架，让多个LLM智能体自主发明并演化紧凑的符号语言协议，通过自适应路由器按需选择与组合这些语言，在保证推理准确率的同时显著降低token开销。
en_tdlr: Proposes CLSR, a test-time framework where multiple LLM agents autonomously invent and evolve compact symbolic language protocols, with an adaptive router selecting and composing these languages per query to optimize the accuracy-token trade-off in multi-agent reasoning.
